category_title: Students with LD who use prior knowledge or memory to predict future story events
scenario_title: Anticipating future events with prior knowledge of the book
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small reading group and anticipating future events in the book 'The Mouse and the Motorcycle'.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are about to read the next part of 'The Mouse and the Motorcycle'. What do you want to find out in the text we are about to read?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Does Ralph have a sister that is going to lose—I mean a brother that is going to try and ride the motorcycle and then ()

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: So usually when we predict, we predict off of what we read so far. Where is that prediction coming from?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well, in third grade my teacher read the book to the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I see. But what can we predict based on what we have read together?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know... it was just a silly prediction.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are about to read the next part of 'The Mouse and the Motorcycle'. What do you want to find out in the text we are about to read?

STUDENT: Does Ralph have a sister that is going to lose—I mean a brother that is going to try and ride the motorcycle and then ()

TUTOR: So usually when we predict, we predict off of what we read so far. Where is that prediction coming from?

STUDENT: Well, in third grade my teacher read the book to the class.

TUTOR: I see. But what can we predict based on what we have read together?

STUDENT: I don't know... it was just a silly prediction.

task.content: Anticipating future events in the story, specifically what they wanted to find out in the text they were about to read
task.learning_goal: Anticipating future events in the story

context.materials: The book 'The Mouse and the Motorcycle'
context.social_setting: Small group with teacher (Sharon) and at least one other student

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher responded with a question that both asserted and elicited accountability to accurate knowledge: 'So usually when we predict, we predict off of what we read so far. Where is that prediction coming from?'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Labeled her own contribution as a 'silly prediction'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Understood the question to imply that she had made a mistake in her response and felt excluded as an individual within the group

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked to make predictions despite having already heard the book read from start to finish
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Provides a question that contains a future event based on prior knowledge rather than the text read so far
